stem.text: A cathode-ray oscilloscope (CRO) is connected to a microphone which detects sound of constant frequency.
The trace on the screen of the CRO is shown.

stem.alt: Oscilloscope screen grid showing a trace of a sine-shaped wave that completes two cycles across the screen.

stem.text: Which property of the sound wave is measured using **only** information from the CRO?
